verdict.rationale: A connectivity platform with an admin API and policy configuration could plausibly offer a test or sandbox tailnet, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a product-provided sandbox or test mode, so the verdict is none. Ephemeral CI nodes, Funnel for testing webhooks on local dev servers, and a community setup splitting dev, staging and prod with ACLs are adjacent features or user-side arrangements, not a documented sandbox capability.
